m1.typescript: m1 every trace gets one reason and a healthy trace is kept by its id

e1.typescript: e1 an error outranks a slow root which outranks retries which outrank a flag

e2.typescript: e2 the root cause is the deepest failing span and its path starts at the root

e3.typescript: e3 a stale or empty retrieval is blamed only when no span failed

e4.typescript: e4 drift reports a move in either direction over the tolerance and never divides by zero

e5.typescript: e5 an alert needs consecutive windows over the threshold and a dip starts the count again

e6.typescript: e6 a log record drops the content fields unless they are allowed by name

e7.typescript: e7 a requests trail joins the events of every component in time order

wrong-error-after-slow.defect: labels a trace that failed and was slow as slow

wrong-no-feedback.defect: drops a trace the user flagged as a bad answer

wrong-retries-ignored.defect: does not keep a trace in which one tool was called three times

wrong-root-reporter.defect: blames the first failing span, which only reported its child's error

wrong-stale-first.defect: blames a stale retrieval even when another span failed

wrong-alert-no-reset.defect: keeps counting windows across a window that was under the threshold

wrong-redact-keeps-content.defect: keeps prompts and tool inputs in the log record

wrong-redact-ignores-allowed.defect: drops a content field even when it is allowed by name

wrong-trail-unsorted.defect: lists a request's events in the order they were received
